commit.subject: build(ui): declare scan and layout dependencies explicitly
commit.body:
The dependency-analysis gate found Dashboard uses core scan types and Network Environment uses foundation layout directly. Declare these dependencies rather than relying on transitive availability.

Verification: GitHub a30e839c passed all 1547 JVM tests and four-ABI Debug compilation. The buildHealth report identified precisely these two missing declarations; rerun the gate and remaining SDK/lint checks for this commit.
